topic: Review gate mismatch for research items
content: Research items that complete their deliverables (conclusion.md, workshop rounds) can still fail the post-execution readiness review because it evaluates scenario-wide code quality, not research output quality. This was observed with swarm-manager-graph-workspace-contract: 4 workshop rounds, 3/3 readiness, but failed due to 230 accumulated code quality violations in the swarm-manager scenario. Either the review pipeline needs research-specific evaluation criteria, or research items should bypass scenario readiness checks.

Significant engineering work happens via commits (12 commits on 2026-03-27 across swarm-manager reliability, web-console UX, DTV updates) that is not reflected in backlog item completions. The backlog system tracks 2 completions total while dozens of commits have landed. Either work is happening outside the initiative system (alignment gap), or items are being completed but not marked (process gap). The director should monitor this gap as it affects the accuracy of portfolio health metrics.
